notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE - Path of the Martyrs
notes.notes:
In the 2.0 update I reworked the boss battles so they are more integrated with the story that surrounds the battle.

I also established a loose story-based connection with my two freeware games "The Heart's Fallacy" and "Blessed Relic Chronis", although each game can be enjoyed separately. There is [b]also a side story that is roughly 2 hours long[/b], and I fixed some more bugs within the game.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/BPqv4xQ/DLC-Screen-Shot2.png[/img]

This side story takes place 1 year before the events of Path of the Martyrs. Machia is going to Trito Town to do her first political interview. However, one day, monsters appear out of nowhere and threaten the livelihood of the people of Trito Town. Can Machia and Saiyato uncover why this town is being targeted?

[img]https://i.ibb.co/sPK9qv5/DLC-Screen-Shot5.png[/img]




*Update available for the Windows version only
